title: Office Floor
goal: A practitioner can read the office floor artefact at a glance.

rubric.must: A visible YOU ARE HERE marker, legend, and two marked exits are present.
Primary and secondary routes visibly lead from the marker to separate exits.
A reader can visually follow the principal flow or relationship from beginning to end.
Key labels remain legible and attached to the correct visible elements.
Lines and symbols do not visually imply unintended connections.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the evacuation/iso exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The drawing clearly presents a legible office escape plan with a YOU ARE HERE marker, distinct eastbound primary and westbound alternative routes, two final exits, and a complete legend. No material visible ambiguity or missing source requirement is apparent.

items.evidence: A prominent YOU ARE HERE marker is visible in the Open Office, the legend is visible at right, and final-exit symbols and labels appear at both West Stair and East Stair.

The routes share the initial descent from the marker into the corridor, then visibly separate: the primary route runs east to the East Stair exit while the alternative route runs west to the West Stair exit.
Green route bands and directional arrowheads make the movement from the Open Office through the corridor to each exit easy to follow at a glance.
Open Office, Corridor, West Stair, East Stair, YOU ARE HERE, FINAL EXIT, extinguisher class ABC, and ASSEMBLY POINT labels are legible and positioned with their corresponding elements.
Route geometry and arrow directions consistently indicate the intended corridor split, with no visible line or symbol suggesting an unintended destination or connection.
